'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2024 Syrian opposition offensives]]
***[[2024 Hama offensive]]
****Rebel forces capture the city of [[Suran, Hama Governorate|Suran]], the towns of [[Halfaya]] and [[Taybat al-Imam]], and the village of [[Maardis]] in [[Hama Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%AE%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D9%8810-%D8%B6%D8%B1%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA/738919/ (SOHR)]
**[[Deir ez-Zor offensive (2024)|Deir ez-Zor offensive]]
***The [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] (SDF) capture seven villages and the town of [[Khasham]] in [[Deir ez-Zor Governorate]] from [[Syrian Armed Forces|pro-government forces]]. The US-led [[Combined Joint Task Force – Operation Inherent Resolve|CJTF–OIR]] coalition aircraft also launch [[airstrike]]s against [[Syrian government]] forces in support of the SDF offensive. [https://www.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/syria/03122024 (Rudaw)]

**The [[Government of Canada]] officially designates the [[Yemen]]-based [[Houthi movement]] as a [[List of organizations designated as terrorist by Canada|terrorist organization]] due to the group's attacks on civilian and military vessels in the [[Red Sea]]. [https://aje.io/dhx4nz?update=3361518 (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A court in [[Ho Chi Minh City]], [[Vietnam]], upholds the [[death penalty]] for real estate tycoon [[Trương Mỹ Lan]] after Lan was found guilty of [[embezzling]] [[US dollar|$]]12.5 billion through the [[Sai Gon Joint Stock Commercial Bank]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/dozens-tourists-go-missing-south-korea-1994843 (Newsweek)] [https://koreajoongangdaily.joins.com/news/2024-12-03/national/socialAffairs/38-Vietnamese-tourists-go-missing-after-entering-Jeju-under-visa-waiver-program/2191367 (''JoongAng Daily'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**During an emergency address to [[South Korea|the nation]], South Korean [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]] declares [[martial law]] in order to clear out alleged "threats posed by [[North Korea]]n [[Korean People's Army|communist forces]] and to eliminate anti-state elements." Yoon says that the decision to declare martial law was made in order to "remove North Korean forces" and to protect South Korea's "liberal constitutional order". [https://world.kbs.co.kr/service/news_view.htm?lang=e&Seq_Code=189470 (KBS)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cn38321180et (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-president-yoon-declares-martial-law-2024-12-03/ (Reuters)] [https://www.barrons.com/news/south-korea-president-declares-emergency-martial-law-99c52b4f (Barrons)]
**[[Republic of Korea Army|South Korean Army]] general [[Park An-su]] is appointed Martial Law Commander by Yoon Suk Yeol, with Park announcing that [[Mass media in South Korea|media organizations]] will be subject to military control and that protests will be banned. [https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20241203162600504 (YNA)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/dec/03/south-korea-declares-emergency-martial-law-yoon-suk-yeol-north-korea-latest-updates (''The Guardian'')]
**Protesters clash with [[National Police Agency (South Korea)|police]] while attempting to storm the [[Korea National Assembly Proceeding Hall|National Assembly]] building in [[Seoul]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/south-korea-martial-law-protests-live-b2658123.html (''The Independent'')]
**In defiance of the declaration of martial law, which prohibits political activities, the [[National Assembly (South Korea)|National Assembly]] votes unanimously to order Yoon Suk Yeol to lift martial law. [[Republic of Korea Armed Forces|Korean soldiers]] that were guarding the National Assembly building withdraw following the vote. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/dec/03/south-korea-declares-emergency-martial-law-yoon-suk-yeol-north-korea-latest-updates (''The Guardian'')]
**Yoon Suk Yeol announces that he will lift the martial law that he declared hours earlier amid staunch opposition from both the opposition and his own [[People Power Party (South Korea)|People Power Party]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-president-yoon-declares-martial-law-2024-12-03/ (Reuters)]

**Palestinian officials announce that [[Fatah]] and [[Hamas]] are close to reaching an agreement on appointing a [[Technocracy|technocratic]] committee to govern the [[Gaza Strip]] following the end of the [[Gaza war]]. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/world/article-palestinian-officials-say-hamas-fatah-are-close-to-agreement-on/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]
